question_text: A doubly linked list is Head→[Lena]↔[Omar]↔[Pr i ya]↔[Theo]←Tail, with null exterior links. Delete Omar, then the tail. Insert Ni a at the beginning. Sketch the final nodes and all links, identifying Head and Tail.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Data order Ni a, Lena, Pr i ya.; Forward links Ni a→Lena→Pr i ya.; Backward links Pr i ya→Lena→Ni a.; Head=Ni a, Tail=Pr i ya, Ni a.prev=None and Pr i ya.next=None.

Backward links Pr i ya→Lena→Ni a.
